lines.en: I walk into the forest, step by step.
Treetops pass beside my shoulders.
My forelegs are longer than my hind.
My steps press shallow pits.
I raise my neck slowly.

lines.zh: 我走过的小树都摇起来
lines.en: Saplings sway as I pass.

lines.zh: 我的身体在树影里发暗
lines.en: My bulk darkens in the tree shade.

lines.zh: 我一步能跨过一条小沟
lines.en: One step carries me over a gully.
My tail drags behind me.

lines.zh: 我沿着林缘走，不进深处
lines.en: I keep to the treeline, not the deep wood.
Needles brush off against my back.
I stop and listen a while.
My shadow is vast.
I shift one step forward.
I raise my head to the high leaves.
I raise my head to eat the high leaves.
The wood is quiet but for wind.
One mouthful of leaves takes me a long while.
My nostrils flare and settle.

lines.zh: 远处有同伴在吃另一棵
lines.en: A companion feeds on another tree.

lines.zh: 我把重心从一条腿换开
lines.en: I shift weight off one leg.

lines.zh: 我背上的苔藓又厚了一层。
lines.en: Another layer of moss settles on my back.
These trees will feed me a long while.
I lower my head to look at the ground.

lines.zh: 有什么东西在树根间动
lines.en: Something moves among the roots.
I snort out a breath.
The wind turns the leaves over.
I chew the tender leaves at the canopy top.
I lower my neck to look at you.

lines.zh: 你站在我脚边，像一株小苗。
lines.en: You stand by my foot like a sapling.
It takes me a while to understand.
You're neither tree nor stone.

lines.zh: 我的鼻孔喷出一股热气
lines.en: A hot breath puffs from my nostrils.
I lift my head back up slowly.
You're standing still. Good.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢有东西在我脚下
lines.en: I dislike things under my feet.

lines.zh: 我挪了一步，树冠让开一片。
lines.en: I shift one step, and the canopy parts.

lines.zh: 我每落一步，地面都闷响。
lines.en: Each step I take makes the ground thud.
You stepped back. That's fine.
I don't want to tread on anything living.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，树叶落下来
lines.en: I give half a step; leaves fall.
My hide is thick. It only stung.
I give a low, muffled bellow.

lines.zh: 我的长颈一缩，撞断树枝。
lines.en: My long neck jerks back and snaps a branch.
I press a pit in the ground.
Not deep, and little blood.
I turn my head toward you.
The tree rocks as I knock it.
I'm not shifting these few steps.
You'd best not do that again.
That handful of leaves you're holding up.
Too small. Not one mouthful.

lines.zh: 我低头瞧了瞧那点叶子
lines.en: I dip my head to inspect the leaves.
The leaves up high are tenderer.

lines.zh: 高处的树冠，我抬脖子就够。
lines.en: The high canopy comes to my raised neck.
Just lay the leaves down.
I don't eat from that low.
Your arm will ache holding it.
I ease over and sniff it.
The ones on the tree are better.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的腿上，像撞树
lines.en: You hit my leg like hitting a tree.
My leg barely shifts.
You're jolted back.
I stop and look down at you.

lines.zh: 你不知道我下一步落哪
lines.en: You don't know where my next step lands.

lines.zh: 这一撞让树叶落了一层
lines.en: The knock brings down a layer of leaves.
I move my foot half a block.
You squeeze past my leg.
I angle my body slowly.
Careful. My feet come down heavy.
Two of us, and this wood is enough.

lines.zh: 我够高处的，你够低处的
lines.en: I'll take the high leaves; you take the low.
Walking abreast, we're loud.
You needn't look up at me.
I've slowed my pace.
At night we stand close.
The tree shade can hide us.

lines.zh: 我抬头，能吃到最高的叶。
lines.en: I lift my head to the highest leaves.
Tomorrow we head for the river valley.
The trees are thicker there.

lines.zh: 我低头，用嘴唇把它卷起来
lines.en: I lower my head and lip it up.

lines.zh: 这小东西，还不到我脚趾高。
lines.en: This little thing is shorter than my toe.

lines.zh: 我把它放到一边的地上
lines.en: I set it on the ground to one side.

lines.zh: 我拿起它，树叶落了一地
lines.en: Picking it up brings down leaves.
You dropped it; I stepped on part.
I nudge it along a stretch.
Not much use, but I won't throw it.
I leave it by the roots.
This stone aches my teeth.
Leave it for another mouth.

lines.zh: 你的脚落进我长长的影里。
lines.en: Your foot lands inside my long shadow.
I turn my neck around.

lines.zh: 两百点生命，抬头比树高。
lines.en: Two hundred health, head above the trees.
This will come down on the ground.
You're standing quite close.
I could step forward.
You're not faster, but you can dodge.
Then let's see about aim.

lines.zh: 我低下头，树影跟着压低。
lines.en: I lower my head, and the tree shadow drops.
My neck comes down with weight.

lines.zh: 你躲到树后，我仍看得见。
lines.en: You hide behind a tree; I still see you.
That tree is thin to me.

lines.zh: 我转过长颈，树冠都在晃。
lines.en: I turn my long neck, and the canopy sways.
Coming down now.
My head reaches the canopy.
You circle to the far side of the tree.
My head turns to follow.

lines.zh: 我的步子太大，不好转向
lines.en: My stride is long and hard to turn.
So I take it slowly.
You won't get far at all.
The gaps between trees are narrow.
Branches have caught you twice.
I hear the leaves move.
That's where you are.
I've raised one foreleg.
I've picked the landing spot.

lines.zh: 我循着晃动的树梢转头。
lines.en: I turn toward the swaying treetops.
My shadow on the ground shifts.
Then it's now.
Don't go thrashing about.
I'd rather not flatten you.
My foreleg slams down beside you.
The ground shakes you off balance.

lines.zh: 这一下把土和叶子掀起来
lines.en: Soil and leaves burst up.
My neck sweeps across.

lines.zh: 我的前腿一推，你撞上树干。
lines.en: One shove of my foreleg sends you into a trunk.
My weight bears down in front of you.
This foot snaps a sapling.
You retreat over broken branches.
I lift the other leg.
Slow, but the ground moves.
This one lands behind you.
Your way back is blocked.

lines.zh: 我的脖子弯下来，罩住你。
lines.en: My neck bends down and closes over you.

lines.zh: 鼻孔里的气吹到你身上
lines.en: My breath blows over you.
You stand, so I stand too.
Then so be it. Don't move.

lines.zh: 我从林子里慢慢走出来
lines.en: I emerge slowly from the wood.
Treetops sway at my shoulders.
Usually one or two of us here.
First I raise my head to the trees.
The high leaves are tender.
I snort and the leaves stir.

lines.zh: 地上的影子把一片草盖住
lines.en: My shadow covers a patch of grass.

lines.zh: 我从林间站起，枝叶抖落。
lines.en: I rise among the trees, shedding leaves.
Roots creak under my steps.
A companion is deeper in the wood.
I eat as I walk.
This wood will feed us a long while.
I raise my head and listen.
There's other movement nearby.
There seems to be something over there.
But I'm in no hurry.
The fire tightens my hide.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滑下，砸出一片土
lines.en: I slide down the slope, tearing up soil.

lines.zh: 水漫过我的背，我挣着抬脖
lines.en: Water covers my back; I strain my neck up.

lines.zh: 气浪把我推得侧了一步
lines.en: The blast shoves me a step sideways.
An arrow sticks in the side of my neck.
That light weakens my legs.
Too starved to raise my neck high.

lines.zh: 雷打在我背上，我晃了晃
lines.en: Lightning strikes my back and I sway.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地面，我直坠下去
lines.en: No ground. I drop straight down.
